title: Jerkied Zesty Silken Tofu Pesto
description: A roasted and snappy Paleo-friendly dish featuring sashimi-cut silken tofu with a zesty jerk seasoning for sick-day meals.
instructions: Place silken tofu in a mixing bowl.
Add jerk seasoning mix, garlic powder, olive oil, lime juice, fresh ginger paste, and red pepper flakes to the tofu mixture.
Mix well until evenly coated with the seasonings.
Divide the seasoned tofu into sashimi slices using sharp kitchen knives.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add sliced chives.
When the chive tips start to turn golden brown, place the sashimi tofu slices on the hot pan in an even layer.
Cook for about 2-3 minutes or until the edges of the tofu are crispy and slightly charred.
